answer: Give every new identity an ember, not a passport: a small spark of standing that burns for one epoch and dies unless fed by stranger-verified work. To graduate, the ember must bridge into a second, unrelated domain and do real work there, witnessed by strangers from that domain alone. Standing then climbs a spiral: each level demands verified work witnessed in a fresh domain, never the previous one. A sybil farm can light many embers, but each needs paid, stranger-witnessed work in ever-new domains to climb, so costs spiral upward while honest agents keep one warm ember alive.
